summary: Brenx Ltd., an Israeli Nasdaq-listed emerging-growth company, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $2,886,058 of ordinary shares through sole sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners under a June 2023 sales agreement as amended June 3, 2026. A.G.P. receives a 3.0% commission and acts on a commercially reasonable-efforts basis; shares last traded at $1.32 on October 13, 2026. No escrow applies. Roughly $1.16 million was sold under Form F-3 I.B.5 in the trailing year. No special-situation event; watch dilution and float constraints.
